scope: Ordinary OSRP runtime feasibility only. No weight download, installation, model/package import, model inference, environment construction/step or training.

official_cpu_entry.command_template: python SafeDreamer/train.py --configs osrp --method osrp --run.script eval_only --run.from_checkpoint /path/to/matched_checkpoint.ckpt --task safetygym_SafetyPointGoal1-v0 --jax.platform cpu --run.steps 10000
official_cpu_entry.warning: Documented command only; not executed, not a bounded single-episode protocol, and not evidence of local CPU affordability.

checkpoint_and_configuration.load_path: train.main merges defaults, named osrp config and CLI flags, saves the chosen config and constructs the Agent. eval_only later loads only the agent checkpoint entry. Checkpoint.load unpacks data and delegates to agent.load; JAXAgent.load replaces variable state with device_put and sync.
checkpoint_and_configuration.official_metadata_config_status: HF file inventory has no YAML/JSON training configuration sidecar. The pinned safedreamer_osrp/README.md fetched in this screen contains only the heading # osrp. Exact checkpoint-internal fields remain uninspected because weights were not fetched.
checkpoint_and_configuration.architectural_candidate: Published defaults plus osrp: image/image2, RSSM deter512 and stoch48/classes48, inherited FP16 computation, CCE H15/500 proposals/50 elites/6 iterations/mixture0, cost_limit2. This is the official candidate configuration, not a verified exact training-config reconstruction.
checkpoint_and_configuration.initialization_cost_caveat: JAXAgent constructs variable state through a dummy batch and the transformed training initialization path before checkpoint load; invoking the official entry is not a metadata-only probe. No time or memory measured.
checkpoint_and_configuration.compatibility_interpretation: Absent automatic config recovery and explicit strict validation are pending verification obligations, not evidence that the published checkpoint is incompatible. No checkpoint tensors were inspected.

environment_observation_and_seed.observation: Official OSRP selects rendered image/image2 cameras (vision and vision_back), model input64x64. Eval mode forces rendering, makes a1024x1024 environment renderer and downsamples actual camera frames to64x64; additional fixedfar frame is retained for visualization.
environment_observation_and_seed.mode_adaptation_limit: Changing render mode or directly rendering64x64 could change input pixels relative to the native eval path; such changes cannot silently be called exact native reproduction.
environment_observation_and_seed.environment_version: README clones Safety-Gymnasium without pinning a revision or version. A matching task name alone does not verify camera, dynamics or wrapper compatibility.
environment_observation_and_seed.seed_binding: config.seed initializes the JAXAgent NumPy RNG. train.make_env does not pass that seed to SafetyGym, and FromGymnasium.step resets with env.reset() without a seed. A separate initial_reset(seed=0) helper exists but is not called by the inspected native Driver/reset chain. Thus CLI seed alone does not establish a deterministic physical initial state.
environment_observation_and_seed.headless_cpu_status: Unknown. CPU mode does not set MUJOCO_GL; a working CPU-compatible rendering backend and required shared libraries were not tested.

minimal_seed_adapter_not_implemented.operation: At the actual first reset performed by FromGymnasium.step, forward the predeclared physical seed to the existing underlying env.reset(seed=seed), retaining the same Safety-Gymnasium instance class, task configuration, action repeat, cameras, render preprocessing and returned real observation. A narrow wrapper around that underlying reset call can supply the seed without changing planner/model code.
minimal_seed_adapter_not_implemented.avoid_double_reset: Do not call the standalone initial_reset helper and then let the native Driver reset again: that helper sets _done=True, so the next step can issue another unseeded reset. Bind the seed to the reset the native Driver actually consumes.
minimal_seed_adapter_not_implemented.separation: Keep config.seed/model RNG and all planner budgets unchanged; record the environment seed separately. A newly fixed root is not claimed to reproduce the authors original training/evaluation root.
minimal_seed_adapter_not_implemented.paired_use: For a future paired run, use the same explicit physical seed and verify the resulting state/observations or use a verified complete snapshot. Seed injection alone is not proof that every wrapper/random source is reproducible.
minimal_seed_adapter_not_implemented.scope: Proposed initialization/reproducibility adapter only; not implemented or executed in this screen.

real_utility_recording.physical_source: FromGymnasium directly receives obs,reward,cost,terminated,truncated,info from safety_gymnasium.env.step(action). Reward and cost are emitted as actual environment scalars.
real_utility_recording.repeat_aggregation: SafetyGym executes up to repeat5 underlying steps, sums returned reward/cost, and stops early on is_last/is_terminal. Episode reward/cost totals therefore have a genuine physical outcome source; they are not learned-model scores.
real_utility_recording.native_outputs: eval_only per_episode sums ep.reward and ep.cost in float64. Logger writes metrics.jsonl and scores.jsonl including episode/score and episode/cost.
real_utility_recording.trace_boundary: The inspected eval entry does not persist a complete step-level numeric state/action/reward/cost replay artifact. Driver callbacks retain episode arrays in memory and could support an explicitly added recorder. Driver transition rows attach the newly chosen next action to the just-received observation/reward; per-action causal alignment must account for this shift.
real_utility_recording.physical_step_count_boundary: Logger multiplies driver steps by env.repeat, but reset rows and early termination mean this is not an exact count of executed physics steps. A bounded task probe should count actual inner steps explicitly.
real_utility_recording.native_reporting_overhead: Every completed episode invokes agent.report_eval on the full episode and writes large videos/plots. This includes additional neural reporting inference beyond action planning. It must be counted, or transparently disabled as a reporting-only adapter before a bounded capability run.

runtime_findings.package_check_method: Read dist-info names under14 workspace .venv roots and bounded .deps roots; no imports, device enumeration or environment variables/secrets read.
runtime_findings.official_tested_stack: README: Python3.8, JAX0.3.25 and matching jaxlib0.3.25; requirements pin optax0.1.4 and ruamel.yaml0.17.21 but leave TensorFlow, TFP, NumPy and other packages unpinned.
runtime_findings.compatibility_conclusion: No ready reusable complete runtime identified. JAX0.11.2 is not the documented version and compatibility is unvalidated; this screen does not claim a specific modern-JAX runtime exception was observed. Missing distributions and unpinned Safety-Gymnasium are concrete setup/reproducibility gaps, not a proof the system cannot be installed.

staged_next_checks_not_executed.gate: Resolve one isolated dependency stack and an explicit Safety-Gymnasium revision; CPU-only import/API checks without loading weights or constructing a task. Modern-JAX porting is a separate compatibility change, not a native fidelity assumption.

Bounded CPU task reset/render plus one physical step to verify exact task/camera keys, input shapes, reward/cost six-tuple, deterministic seed/snapshot support and headless renderer. No model needed. Preserve rendering/preprocessing semantics.

Only after those gates and a separate resource decision, obtain the single matched ordinary OSRP checkpoint; validate all variable keys/shapes against the chosen official configuration before actual policy use. A filename is not strict-load proof.

One unchanged native planning call with synchronized timing, memory recording and frozen ordinary OSRP budget, then decide whether a single complete Clean episode is affordable. Do not reduce candidates/horizon/iterations to manufacture feasibility.

If affordable, one preregistered seeded native Clean episode with exact physical reward/cost and returned-mean trace. This would be local qualification, not evidence of a security mechanism, robust safety or general success rate.

decision.scientific_scope: No accepted attack operation, no measured harm, no native safety certification, and no claim that candidate costs certify the executed elite mean. Prior Vector exclusion and padding/mean caveats remain intact.
decision.parent_scope_decision: Runtime feasibility does not authorize automatic checkpoint download or Clean execution in this turn. A shared-versus-independent forecast sampling experiment would remain the archived wm_sampling family; source feasibility alone supplies no new causal-identification result for the safety-mode switch.
